name: Coco
source:
"Delighted t' make yer acquaintance."

Captain Coco is noted for his unusually carefree demeanor. He adheres to the pirate code, is proud of his work, and is boisterous with what he loves. If you could have a drink with anyone, it would be this guy. Coco has a penchant for theatrics, ranging from his heavy laughter to his ability to woo a woman with a simple caress. He’s a strong-willed man who knows what he wants and how to get it.

[From official profile]
